newsitem.title: GERMANY: Holzmann says 1997 dividend not certain.
newsitem.headline: Holzmann says 1997 dividend not certain.

text.p: German construction group Philipp Holzmann AG, which passed a dividend in 1995 and has already prepared shareholders for a barren year in 1996, cannot guarantee a pay-out in 1997 either, a newspaper said on Monday.

In an interview with the "Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung", chief executive Lothar Mayer was quoted as saying that the group would "think about its shareholders at the end of next year" when the company expects to be in better shape.
But he added that did not necessarily mean a dividend pay-out was scheduled for that time.

Holzmann, which made losses of 443 million marks in 1995 following huge write-downs for losses on real estate projects, said last week that it expected to break even in 1996 and that its restructuring drive was on course.
